unavailable_fields.nvlink_bytes: Capability probe reports status unknown: hardware counters require a successful collector-specific probe; NVLink traffic must not be invented from logical payload or memcpy sizes; observed transport channels are SHM/direct/direct.
unavailable_fields.hardware_utilization: Capability probe reports status unknown: hardware counters require a successful collector-specific probe; available NVML utilization samples are device-wide readings with native windows.

rationale: Candidate 0fbf76bb (bundle trial-8469963975-param-b9372525, declared route invoke:fused-single-allreduce) improved the frozen objective (clean communication_kernel_sum_ms 33.12/33.06 vs original 53.63 max-rank; parent discovery showed 196.14/34.00 ms over 13 allreduces, 12x28,351,488B + 1x157,541,376B f32, all ncclDevKernel_AllReduce_Sum_f32_RING_LL over SHM/direct/direct channels, with rank-0 per-collective kernel duration ~13.9ms vs rank-1 ~1.86ms, i.e. dominated by device waiting) but failed the step_ms constraint (127.07 vs limit 120.90, original 115.14), with peak_allocated_bytes up ~504MB consistent with a large flat buffer. The open uncertainty is attribution of the ~12ms step regression, not the collective inventory (payload coverage 13/13, zero unmatched communication kernels, transport observed); the fused route label is candidate-reported telemetry needing trace corroboration. Selected collectors each resolve one branch: binding_cost, because the candidate is additive (requested legacy, effective direct, reason 'no functional replacements', which does not imply zero binding overhead) and clean AB/BA whole-invocation parent-vs-binding-passthrough tests the host/binding branch; execution_timeline, whose per-device intervals, CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization events and passive post-accumulate callbacks test the serialization/loss-of-overlap branch and the ordering of the fused collective; nccl_tuning, because kernel entry names alone do not identify protocol and the actual algorithm/protocol/channel decisions at the observed 157,541,376B and 28,351,488B f32 sizes in a warmed worker determine whether the collective implementation (parent used RING_LL even for the 157MB bucket) explains the residual kernel cost; nsys (available at tools.nsys) for the cross-rank timeline to locate GPU gaps and exposed communication behind the step regression, accepting that nsys cannot separate NCCL waiting from wire transfer or prove bucket identity. Excluded: torch (already ran; its 3 diagnostic profiled invocations supply the candidate kernel sums), python_runtime (perturbs execution and its inclusive/self cProfile times are not clean performance scores; binding is effective-direct so binding_cost covers the host-cost question cleanly), collective_calibration (a synthetic full-world SUM allreduce reference with correctness checks, not a lower bound or critical-path estimate; it does not attribute the regression), device_telemetry (device-wide NVML rates/utilization with native windows, not per-collective bytes; transport already observed), candidate_diagnostics (endpoint passed with quality_and_coverage_valid, 0 framework fallbacks and no exception evidence to chase; empty events would not establish which successful path executed). No failure-category policy or optimization action is prescribed; this collection only grounds the attribution for the listed revision.
